name: creative-hover-card

frames.best_why: The first card is mid-hover, showing its switched badge, new title and bowl photo beside two resting cards.

tagline: Three dark cards swap badges, titles and photos when hovered.
summary: A row of three dark feature cards, each with a coloured tag, a heading, a short line of copy and a photo that fades to a second image on hover while the title and tag change.
appearance: Three dark, rounded cards sit side by side on black. Each opens with a small coloured pill tag, then a bold pale heading, a line or two of grey copy and a wide photo filling the lower half, all softly bordered.
behaviour: Hovering a card flips its tag to a new colour, swaps the heading for alternate wording and cross-fades the photo to a different image while nudging it up a few pixels. Each card changes on its own.
demo_content: Cards tagged Statistic, Password and Alert show subscriber, password and chat themes.
search_phrases: three cards with image swap on hover
use_when: A features row should feel alive and show more depth on hover without opening a modal.
avoid_when: Every meaningful change happens on hover, so touch and keyboard users only ever see the resting cards.
customise: The three cards, their copy, images and colours are all written inline; adapting them means editing each card's markup. No props.
weight_why: Six images and CSS opacity and transform transitions; nothing runs until hover.

a11y.note: All changes require hover on non-focusable divs, so keyboard users get none of it, and alt text repeats 'Card image 01'.

issues: Hover-only changes are unreachable by keyboard or touch.
Every image shares the alt text 'Card image 01'.
polish_why: Tidy three-card row with snappy swaps; cramped body copy and unrelated stock photos weaken it.
title: Creative Hover Card
